compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, batch 1, lr 1e-4, 200 steps, institutional HPC 2x H100 NVL, 12 lanes total, wall time ~1.5 min for 27 cells.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: param-side Gini at r=64/rho=0.95 corner <=0.30 AND fire-rate <27/27. PARTIAL: Gini 0.30-0.40. DOESN'T: Gini >=0.40 + fire 27/27.
schema: K15p GraLoRA-style rank-bottleneck intervention: effective r = max(1, r // 4), alpha matched to FULL rank for magnitude parity. Tests ADAPTER-STRUCTURE axis. MDLM-OWT 130M, r in {4,16,64} x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds = 27 cells.
verdict_explanation: DOESN'T: fire 27/27 unchanged, fire-step median 11 identical to K15a baseline, step-0 top-1 identical, paired delta on all metrics ~0. Rank-bottleneck (effective rank reduced 4x while alpha-scaled to FULL rank) does not prevent saturation. Rules out adapter-structure axis. Param-side max-grad ratio 2.0x vs baseline (lower effective rank with full alpha = larger per-matrix update magnitude) but saturation pattern unchanged.
